chunks.heading: OPERATION PROHIBITION
prerequisites: WARNING:

text_blocks.text: Parts with strong magnet is used in this vehicle.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Technicians using a medical electric device such as pacemaker must never perform operation on the vehicle, as magnetic field can affect the device function by approaching to such parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: NORMAL CHARGE PRECAUTION
prerequisites: WARNING:

If  a  technician  uses  a  medical  electric  device  such  as  an  implantable  cardiac  pacemaker  or  an implantable cardioverter defibrillator, the possible effects on the devices must be checked with the device manufacturer before starting the charge operation.

text_blocks.text: If  a  technician  uses  a  medical  electric  device  such  as  an  implantable  cardiac  pacemaker  or  an implantable cardioverter defibrillator, the possible effects on the devices must be checked with the device manufacturer before starting the charge operation.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: As  radiated  electromagnetic  wave  generated  by  PDM  (Power  Delivery  Module)  at  normal  charge operation may affect medical electric devices, a technician using a medical electric device such as implantable cardiac pacemaker or an implantable cardioverter defibrillator must not approach motor room [PDM (Power Delivery Module)] at the hood-opened condition during normal charge operation.
text_blocks.label: list_item

prerequisites: WARNING:

If a technician uses other medical electric devices than implantable cardiac pacemaker or implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD), the electromagnetic wave of TCU might affect the function of the device. The possible effects on the devices must be checked with the device manufacturer before TCU use.

chunks.heading: Precaution for Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) "AIR BAG" and "SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONER"

text_blocks.text: Precaution for Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) "AIR BAG" and "SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONER"
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: The Supplemental Restraint System such as 'AIR BAG' and 'SEAT BELT PRE-TENSIONER', used along with a front seat belt, helps to reduce the risk or severity of injury to the driver and front passenger for certain types of collision. This system includes seat belt switch inputs and dual stage front air bag modules. The SRS
text_blocks.label: text

chunks.heading: PRECAUTIONS
prerequisites: WARNING:

To avoid rendering the SRS inoperative, which could increase the risk of personal injury or death in the event of a collision which would result in air bag inflation, all maintenance must be performed by an authorized NISSAN/INFINITI dealer.

text_blocks.text: system uses the seat belt switches to determine the front air bag deployment, and may only deploy one front air bag, depending on the severity of a collision and whether the front occupants are belted or unbelted. Information necessary to service the system safely is included in the SR and SB section of this Service Manual.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: To avoid rendering the SRS inoperative, which could increase the risk of personal injury or death in the event of a collision which would result in air bag inflation, all maintenance must be performed by an authorized NISSAN/INFINITI dealer.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Improper maintenance, including incorrect removal and installation of the SRS, can lead to personal injury caused by unintentional activation of the system. For removal of Spiral Cable and Air Bag Module, see the SR section.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Do not use electrical test equipment on any circuit related to the SRS unless instructed to in this Service Manual. SRS wiring harnesses can be identified by yellow and/or orange harnesses or harness connectors.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: PRECAUTIONS WHEN USING POWER TOOLS (AIR OR ELECTRIC) AND HAMMERS
prerequisites: WARNING:
When using air or electric power tools or hammers, always switch the Ignition OFF, disconnect the battery and wait at least three minutes before performing any service.

text_blocks.text: PRECAUTIONS WHEN USING POWER TOOLS (AIR OR ELECTRIC) AND HAMMERS
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: When working near the Airbag Diagnosis Sensor Unit or other Airbag System sensors with the Ignition ON or engine running, DO NOT use air or electric power tools or strike near the sensor(s) with a hammer. Heavy vibration could activate the sensor(s) and deploy the air bag(s), possibly causing serious injury.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When using air or electric power tools or hammers, always switch the Ignition OFF, disconnect the battery and wait at least three minutes before performing any service.
text_blocks.label: list_item

prerequisites: CAUTION: When the 12V battery is removed, plural DTC may be detected. After installing 12V battery, always perform 'All DTC' with CONSULT and delete DTC.

chunks.heading: High Voltage Precautions
prerequisites: WARNING:
Be sure to remove the service plug in order to shut off the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.

text_blocks.text: Because hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled  incorrectly.  Be  sure  to  follow  the  correct  work  procedures  when  performing  inspection  and maintenance.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to shut off the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: To prevent the removed service plug from being connected by mistake during the procedure, always carry it in your pocket or put it in the tool box.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield, and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Clearly identify the persons responsible for high voltage work and ensure that other persons do not touch the vehicle. When not working, cover high voltage parts with an insulating cover sheet or similar item to prevent other persons from contacting them.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: There is the possibility of a malfunction occurring if the vehicle is changed to READY status while the service plug is removed. Therefore do not change the vehicle to READY status unless instructed to do so in the Service Manual.
text_blocks.label: text

chunks.heading: HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS AND EQUIPMENT IDENTIFICATION

text_blocks.text: HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS AND EQUIPMENT IDENTIFICATION
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: The colors of the high voltage harnesses and connectors are all orange. Orange "High Voltage" labels are applied to the Li-ion battery and other high voltage devices. Do not carelessly touch these harnesses and parts.
text_blocks.label: text

chunks.heading: HANDLING OF HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS AND TERMINALS

text_blocks.text: HANDLING OF HIGH VOLTAGE HARNESS AND TERMINALS
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Immediately insulate disconnected high voltage connectors and terminals with insulating tape.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: A Li-ion battery with flat construction is placed under floor.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The battery pack is equipped with necessary devices, such as Liion battery controller, battery junction box, and service plug in addition to a battery storing electricity.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Four cells are integrated into a single module. The Li-ion battery consists of 48 modules placed in series.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Li-ion battery controller (LBC) is included in the battery pack and installed on the left surface of the rear module stack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The LBC is the core of battery control. Li-ion battery controller detects the voltage and current of the assembled battery, the temperature of each module, and the voltage of each cell to judge state of charge. LBC also calculates possible input/output values, meter indication values, and chargeable values, and send this data to VCM (Vehicle control module). VCM controls the vehicle, according to the battery state.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: Main Role of Li-ion Battery Controller

text_blocks.text: Main Role of Li-ion Battery Controller
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Detection of decrease in insulation resistance of high-voltage circuit
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Detection of a fit of high voltage harness connector and service plug
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Four laminated cells are integrated into one module.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The Li-ion battery is equipped with 48 modules.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: There are two kinds of modules, according to the location of positive and negative terminals.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: A module consists of two parallel-connected cells placed in series. The Li-ion battery has 48 modules placed in series in total. Ninety-six parallel-connected cell pairs are connected in series.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Cell voltage displayed on the data monitor of CONSULT means the potential  difference  between  the  upstream  and  the  downstream of the parallel circuit.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: The highest potential is module (MD) 1 and the lowest is module (MD) 48.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: These are thin laminated cells with excellent cooling performance.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Large surface area with excellent cooling performance reduces heat load to the battery and improves battery life.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Light and thin structure increases flexibility in layout.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The heater relay unit is installed in the battery pack (under the service plug).
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When receiving a relay control signal from LBC (Li-ion battery controller),  the  heater  relay  unit  turns  ON  the  built-in  relay  and  supplies high-voltage power to each Li-ion battery heater.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Li-ion battery heater is installed in the battery pack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: High voltage power is supplied from the heater relay unit.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Each Li-ion battery heater is connected in parallel.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Two front Li-ion battery heaters are installed to each front module stack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Two  rear  Li-ion  battery  heaters  are  installed  to  the  rear  module stack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The battery current sensor is installed to bus bar between battery junction box and rear module stack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: This sensor measures charge/discharge current sent to Li-ion battery  and  transmits  a  current  signal  to  Li-ion  battery  controller (LBC).
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Li-ion  Battery  controller  (LBC)  measures  remaining  battery  level according to charge/discharge current and sends the data to VCM.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Three battery temperature sensors mounted in the battery pack measure the temperature.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The installation position of the sensors are;
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: -Front module stack RH: Two for front and rear
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The sensor uses a thermistor with a resistance value that varies according to changes in temperature. The electrical resistance of the thermistor decreases as the temperature increases.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The battery junction box is installed to the front side in the battery pack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: -System main relay to provide/interrupt DC current sent from Li-ion battery.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: -Pre-charge relay to protect the high voltage circuit from a high current immediately after power switch ON.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Installed to both positive side and negative side, the system main relay provides DC current to each high voltage part. In addition, the system main relay provides DC current to the Li-ion battery during motor regeneration or charge.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When  an  error  occurs  in  the  system,  the  system  main  relay  is turned OFF and the Li-ion battery is interrupted for ensuring safety, based on a command from VCM (Vehicle control module). JSCIA0276ZZ
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The service plug is included in the Li-ion battery to securely disconnect the high voltage during high voltage part inspection and maintenance.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The service plug is installed on the upper surface of the battery pack. The plug can be removed when the leg-room mounted service plug cover is removed.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Always  use  insulating  protective  equipment  when  removing  and installing service plug.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The Li-ion battery controller (LBC) monitors the status of the inside of the Li-ion battery at all times and sends information, such as the charging status of Li-ion battery and possible power, to VCM (vehicle control module) via EV system CAN communication.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: The Li-ion battery controller performs control as per the following.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Monitors the battery state and transfers chargeable/dischargeable power to VCM to prevent an error, such as overvoltage, over discharge or excessive temperature rise in the battery.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Detects an error (overvoltage, over discharge, overcurrent, or excessive temperature rise) immediately at the time of error occurrence and requests VCM to disconnect the system main relay to interrupt the discharge/charge line.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Maintains the optimum battery state constantly with a cell capacity adjustment function to prevent a reduction in charging/discharging capacity caused by cell capacity variations.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Detects the connector fit state with the function to detect the fit of the high voltage harness connector and transfers the detected state to VCM so that the vehicle does not start with an unsteady state.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Detects the insulation resistance state with the function to detect the insulation resistance between high and low voltage and transfers the detected state to VCM so that the vehicle does not start with an unusual state.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Estimates a battery charge state and low battery state, based on the data obtained with the battery state detection function, and reflects on the battery capacity meter.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The Li-ion  battery  has  a  voltage  range  capable  of  charge/discharge.  If  charged/discharged  exceeding  the range, excessive low capacity or malfunction may be caused. To prevent this, the Li-ion battery controller detects voltage of each cell and requests the control of charging/discharging energy to VCM so that the cell voltage stays within the voltage range.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: During cell capacity adjustment, the capacity of each cell is estimated based on the no-load voltage when the system starts, and the capacities are adjusted so that they are all at the target level. The voltage of each cell is detected inside the Li-ion battery controller. The bypass switches are then turned ON to discharge the cells that have excess capacity. In this way, capacity adjustment by the Li-ion battery controller allows the capacity of all cells to be fully utilized.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: The insulation resistance detection circuit mounted inside the Li-ion battery controller measures the insulation resistance of each high voltage part and sends the measurement results to VCM via EV system CAN communication.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: VCM judges abnormal insulation resistance in each high voltage part, based on the received insulation resistance value.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: When the temperature decreases [approximately -20 ° C ( -4 ° F)] extremely in the battery pack, the Li-ion battery heater control system automatically activates the Li-ion battery heater to warm the inside of the battery pack for protecting Li-ion battery from freezing and preventing the decline in battery output. In addition, when the temperature in the battery pack is restored [approximately -10 ° C (14 ° F)], the Li-ion battery heater stops.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The Li-ion battery controller (LBC) detects a temperature in the battery pack, according to a signal transmitted from the battery temperature sensor installed to the battery pack and judges the activation of the Li-ion battery heater.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When the relay built in the heater relay unit turns ON, high voltage power is supplied to each Li-ion battery heater.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: LBC detects the ON/OFF status of the relay built in to heater relay unit.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Even when the power switch is OFF, VCM periodically activates LBC to protect Li-ion battery from freezing.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When the temperature in Li-ion battery pack is low with no necessity of Li-ion battery heater operation, LBC estimates the time that Li-ion battery may freeze and transmits a next start time signal to VCM via EV system CAN communication to prepare for starting the Li-ion battery heater next time.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When receiving a next start time signal via EV system CAN communication, VCM transmits a start request signal (CHG-IGN) to LBC after a lapse of the set time. When receiving a start request signal (CHG-IGN), LBC activates the Li-ion battery heater.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When the temperature in the battery pack is low outside the timer charge set time, VCM transmits a keep SOC request signal to LBC via EV system CAN communication. In this case Li-ion battery is not charged, and only Li-ion battery heater is activated.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When timer charge starts at the set time, Li-ion batter is charged, and the Li-ion battery heater is activated.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When EVSE is not connected (normal charge)
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: When the charge level of the Li-ion battery is low during the Li-ion battery heater operation, LBC stops the Li-ion battery heater operation even if the temperature in the battery pack is insufficient.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: To improve the Li-ion battery life, never perform quick charge heavily.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Use the method of nighttime normal charge or timer-controlled charge.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Never place EV battery in an area exposed to direct sunlight or under high temperature conditions.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: PRECAUTIONS FOR STORAGE OF THE LI-ION BATTERY

text_blocks.text: PRECAUTIONS FOR STORAGE OF THE LI-ION BATTERY
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Apply insulating tape to the service plug and high voltage harness connector, and protect the terminals so that nothing contacts them.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Store in a well-ventilated location that is not exposed to direct sunlight.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Never set directly on the floor.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Lay an anti-static rubber sheet underneath the battery.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Cover with an anti-static cover sheet.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Put a caution display stating "CAUTION! HIGH VOLTAGE" on the insulated cover sheet.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Put identification display showing the name of person in charge on the insulated cover sheet.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Never allow water to contact the battery.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Prevent other objects from falling onto the battery.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: Description
prerequisites: If a malfunction (e.g. abnormal voltage) occurs in a Li-ion battery cell, the module which includes the malfunctioning cell must be replaced. When replacing a module with a new one, its voltage is required to be adjusted to the adjusting voltage calculated from the maximum cell voltage of normal cells.

text_blocks.text: If a malfunction (e.g. abnormal voltage) occurs in a Li-ion battery cell, the module which includes the malfunctioning cell must be replaced. When replacing a module with a new one, its voltage is required to be adjusted to the adjusting voltage calculated from the maximum cell voltage of normal cells.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Voltage adjustment under low temperature conditions may require a long time. To prevent this from occurring, it is advisable to adjust voltage under room temperature conditions [20 ° C ± 10 ° C (68 ° F ± 18 ° F)].
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Double the 'MAXIMUM CELL VOLTAGE' and use that value as the module adjustment value.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Example: 3.925 V (MAXIMUM CELL VOLTAGE) × 2 = 7.850 V (Adjustment voltage value)
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.

chunks.heading: Diagnosis Procedure
prerequisites: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
WARNING:
Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.

text_blocks.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: Refer to EVB-6, "High Voltage Precautions".

chunks.heading: Diagnosis Procedure
prerequisites: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
WARNING:
Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.

text_blocks.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: Diagnosis Procedure
prerequisites: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
WARNING:
Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.

text_blocks.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.

text_blocks.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.

prerequisites: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
WARNING:

text_blocks.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.
text_blocks.label: list_item

data_raw: When no CAN communication signal is received continu- ously for 2 seconds or more.

text_blocks.text: CAN (Controller Area Network) is a serial communication line for real time applications. It is an on-vehicle multiplexcommunication line with high data communication speed and excellent error detection ability. Modern vehicle is equipped with many electronic control units, and each control unit shares information and links with other control units during operation (not independent). In CAN communication, control units are connected with 2 communication lines (CAN-H, CAN-L) allowing a high rate of information transmission with less wiring. Each control unit transmits/receives data but selectively reads the required data only.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: CAN communication signal chart. Refer to LAN-36, "CAN COMMUNICATION SYSTEM : CAN Communication Signal Chart".
text_blocks.label: text

chunks.heading: ENVIRONMENT FOR LI-ION BATTERY DISASSEMBLY WORK
prerequisites: Must be an indoor environment.

text_blocks.text: ENVIRONMENT FOR LI-ION BATTERY DISASSEMBLY WORK
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: The environment must utilize a shutter or other means to shut out the outside environment and prevent rain, snow, dust, or other substances from entering.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The environment must not cause the intrusion of sweat during work, or cause condensation to occur due to high temperature or humidity.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Metal powder, grease, and other foreign substances must not enter.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The indoor environment must also prevent metal powder, grease, and other foreign substances from entering due to maintenance performed on other vehicles and other sources during disassembly work.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: If there is a risk of the above substances entering, take appropriate countermeasures, such as use of a vinyl curtain or an equivalent to shut out the outside environment.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The floor must not be wet as a result of factors such as vehicle entry during rain or snow.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The work space must be approximately the size of one entire vehicle.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Take appropriate countermeasures so that persons other than the operator do not enter the work space, such as by placing signs indicating that disassembly work is in progress.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Always place a standard fire fighting equipment in the disassembly work area.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Depending  on  type  of  fire  (vehicle  or  battery)  use  standard  fire  fighting  equipment  (water  or  extinguisher).
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Clean any dust or dirt adhered to the battery pack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Remove the battery pack upper case mounting bolts and ground bolts .
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Cut the battery pack upper case adhesive according to the following procedure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Sharpen the blade of the windshield cutter .
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Apply a tape for preventing damage to the battery pack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Use the windshield cutter and cut the adhesive in the order from 1 to 4 as shown in the figure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When cutting the adhesive, be careful to avoid scratching the battery pack coating to the maximum extent possible.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The paint sealant is set between the paint sealant marks stamped on the battery pack upper case (between to ). Therefore be careful not to damage the paint sealant when cutting the adhesive.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Because the paint sealant functions to release pressure from inside the battery pack, if the paint sealant is damaged beyond the limit, the battery pack lower case must be replaced. If the paint sealant  damage  is  less  than  the  limit,  repair  by  applying  primer  (adhesive  primer:  999MP43533PP).
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Continuous length of undamaged section: : 210 mm (8.27 in) or more
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Because there is no clearance at the embossed part, cut the adhesive there last.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Set the windshield cutter (A) at an angle of 90 ° to the surface of the battery case.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Hold the windshield cutter facing toward the grip, and cut the adhesive while holding the blade level.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Use piano wire (A) to cut the adhesive at the battery pack corners.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: CAUTION: When cutting the adhesive, be careful to avoid scratching the battery pack coating and paint sealant to the maximum extent possible. NOTE:
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Press the piano wire against the adhesive at the battery pack corner, and pull it in alternate directions for cutting of adhesive.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Use the windshield cutter (A) for cutting adhesive at the embossed locations.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Insert a plastic remover tool (B) into the embossed locations to open a clearance. CAUTION:
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Do not press the remover tool farther in than necessary. Doing so may deform the battery pack upper case.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Tilt the windshield cutter blade at an angle and cut the adhesive at the embossed locations. CAUTION:
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When cutting the adhesive, be careful to avoid scratching the battery pack coating to the maximum extent possible.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Remove the battery pack upper case.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Check that the adhesive is fully cut before removing. Use of excessive force during removal may deform the battery pack upper case.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When removing the battery pack upper case, be careful that cutting particles do not enter the battery pack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: If  adhesive cutting particles enter the battery pack, clean (use of air blow is prohibited) when assembling so that no particles remain on the battery module, bus bar, and high-voltage harness.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Operation must be performed by 2 persons. Be careful that the battery pack upper case does not contact the battery module.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: To remove remaining adhesive on the battery pack upper case and battery pack lower case ,  use a scraper (B), and cut so that the surface is smooth, leaving approximately 1 - 2 mm (0.04 - 0.08 in) of adhesive behind.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Because airtightness leakage is likely to occur, cut the seal in such a way that burrs are not produced.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be careful not to damage the paint sealant.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: -If the paint sealant on a straight section is damaged in excess of the limit, the battery pack lower case must be replaced. If  the  paint  sealant  damage  is  less  than  the  limit,  repair  by  applying primer (adhesive primer: 999MP-43533PP).
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Continuous length of undamaged section: : 210 mm (8.27 in) or more
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: -If the paint sealant damage on a corner is damaged, repair by applying primer (adhesive primer: 999MP-43533PP).
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Leave 1 - 2 mm (0.04 - 0.08 in) of adhesive so that the battery pack coating surface and paint sealant are not damaged.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Sharpen the blade of the scraper.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Repair scratches to the battery pack upper case by the following procedure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: Protect the seal with masking tape . NOTE:

text_blocks.text: Protect the seal with masking tape . NOTE:
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: If  primer surfacer (anti-corrosion primer) contacts the seal, the adhesive strength is reduced.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Spray primer surfacer (anti-corrosion primer) (B) into the cracks in the battery pack upper case.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Install a carabiner (A) onto the bracket of the battery pack upper case.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: This is to provide a handle for use after the adhesive is applied and prevent adhesive from adhering to the operator's hands.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Apply dam rubber (KA390-0059U) on the inside of the old adhesive on the battery pack lower case.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: CAUTION: If dam rubber is already applied there, replace it with new dam rubber. NOTE:
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Apply the dam rubber so that adhesive does not enter the inner side. If the adhesive enters the inner side, then the next time the battery pack is disassembled, the windshield cutter may not be able to reach the adhesive and removing the battery pack upper case may be difficult.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Apply adhesive (999MP-57302NP) to the battery pack lower case as shown in the figure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Because there is a risk of airtightness leakage, apply the adhesive so that there are no seams or overlaps.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Complete installation of the battery pack upper case before the adhesive surface hardens. The adhesive begins to harden in as little as 12 minutes. [Humidity: 80%, Temperature: 35 ° C (95 ° F)]
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Before installing the battery pack upper case, check that there are no locations of insufficient adhesive. If there is insufficient adhesive, correct the location. (If the adhesive height is lower than the height of the dam rubber, then the amount of adhesive is insufficient.)
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Do not apply too much adhesive as doing so may make work difficult the next time the battery pack upper case is removed.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: For applying the adhesive in a triangle, cut the end of the nozzle as shown in the figure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Nozzle inner diameter (A) : Approx. 5 mm (0.20 in)
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Grasp the carabiner installed in Step 3, and install the battery pack upper case while visually aligning the alignment holes on the battery pack upper case and battery pack lower case .
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Operation  must  be  performed  by  2  persons.  Be  careful that the battery pack upper case does not contact the battery module.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Moving the upper case after it is installed makes airtightness  leakage  more  likely.  Therefore,  position  the  upper case carefully.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Tighten the mounting bolts in the order from 1 to 6 as shown in the figure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Perform a battery pack air leak inspection. Refer to EVB-269, "Inspection". CAUTION:
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: If air leakage occurs, remove the battery pack upper case and wipe off the adhesive, then apply new dam rubber and apply adhesive again. (Proceed to Step 4.)
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Spray primer surfacer (anti-corrosion primer) (A) into cracks in the periphery of the battery pack adhesive.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: After the battery pack is assembled, it can be installed into the vehicle. However the battery pack must not be subjected to any external force (such as high-pressure washing or parking in a location which strains the vehicle body) for approximately 3 hours after installation.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to reinstall the high voltage harness clips in their original positions. If a clip is damaged, replace it with a new clip before installing.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: After assembling the battery pack, perform an electric equipotential test.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Check the following items after installing battery pack: Refer to EVB-269, "Inspection".
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Remove the battery pack upper case. EVB-204, "BATTERY PACK UPPER CASE : Removal and Installation".

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.

text_blocks.text: The Li-ion battery controller includes 2 harness connectors: a high-voltage connector and a low-voltage connector . text_blocks.text: FRONT MODULE STACK : Removal and Installation

text_blocks.text: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to shut off the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to put the removed service plug in pocket and carry it or store it in a tool box or other container so that another person does not accidentally connect it while work is in progress.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to put on insulating protective gear before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Clearly identify the persons responsible for high voltage work and ensure that other persons do not touch the vehicle. When not working, cover high voltage components with an anti-static cover sheet or similar item to prevent contact with other persons.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: If the battery pack is to be disassembled, be sure to remove the Li-ion battery controller for preventing electric shock, fire, and damage to parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: CAUTION: There is the possibility of a malfunction occurring if the vehicle is changed to READY status while the service plug is removed. Therefore do not change the vehicle to READY status unless instructed to do so in the Service Manual.

text_blocks.text: The environment must utilize a shutter or other means to shut out the outside environment and prevent rain, snow, dust, or other substances from entering.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The environment must not cause the intrusion of sweat during work, or cause condensation to occur due to high temperature or humidity.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Metal powder, grease, and other foreign substances must not enter.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The indoor environment must also prevent metal powder, grease, and other foreign substances from entering due to maintenance performed on other vehicles and other sources during disassembly work.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: If there is a risk of the above substances entering, take appropriate countermeasures, such as use of a vinyl curtain or an equivalent to shut out the outside environment.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The floor must not be wet as a result of factors such as vehicle entry during rain or snow.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The work space must be approximately the size of one entire vehicle.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Take appropriate countermeasures so that persons other than the operator do not enter the work space, such as by placing signs indicating that disassembly work is in progress.

chunks.heading: FRONT MODULE STACK : Disassembly and Assembly
prerequisites: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
WARNING:

text_blocks.text: FRONT MODULE STACK : Disassembly and Assembly
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to shut off the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to put the removed service plug in pocket and carry it or store it in a tool box or other container so that another person does not accidentally connect it while work is in progress.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Be sure to put on insulating protective gear before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Clearly identify the persons responsible for high voltage work and ensure that other persons do not touch the vehicle. When not working, cover high voltage components with an anti-static cover sheet or similar item to prevent contact with other persons.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: If the battery pack is to be disassembled, be sure to remove the Li-ion battery controller for preventing electric shock, fire, and damage to parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: CAUTION: There is the possibility of a malfunction occurring if the vehicle is changed to READY status while the service plug is removed. Therefore do not change the vehicle to READY status unless instructed to do so in the Service Manual.
text_blocks.label: section_header

chunks.heading: ENVIRONMENT FOR LI-ION BATTERY DISASSEMBLY WORK
prerequisites: Must be an indoor environment.

text_blocks.text: ENVIRONMENT FOR LI-ION BATTERY DISASSEMBLY WORK
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: The environment must utilize a shutter or other means to shut out the outside environment and prevent rain, snow, dust, or other substances from entering.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The environment must not cause the intrusion of sweat during work, or cause condensation to occur due to high temperature or humidity.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Metal powder, grease, and other foreign substances must not enter.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The indoor environment must also prevent metal powder, grease, and other foreign substances from entering due to maintenance performed on other vehicles and other sources during disassembly work.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: If there is a risk of the above substances entering, take appropriate countermeasures, such as use of a vinyl curtain or an equivalent to shut out the outside environment.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The floor must not be wet as a result of factors such as vehicle entry during rain or snow.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The work space must be approximately the size of one entire vehicle.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Take appropriate countermeasures so that persons other than the operator do not enter the work space, such as by placing signs indicating that disassembly work is in progress.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Always place a standard fire fighting equipment in the disassembly work area.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Depending  on  type  of  fire  (vehicle  or  battery)  use  standard  fire  fighting  equipment  (water  or  extinguisher).
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Clearly identify the persons responsible for high voltage work and ensure that other persons do not touch the vehicle. When not working, cover high voltage components with an anti-static cover sheet or similar item to prevent contact with other persons.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: If the battery pack is to be disassembled, be sure to remove the Li-ion battery controller for preventing electric shock, fire, and damage to parts.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: CAUTION: There is the possibility of a malfunction occurring if the vehicle is changed to READY status while the service plug is removed. Therefore do not change the vehicle to READY status unless instructed to do so in the Service Manual.
text_blocks.label: section_header

chunks.heading: ENVIRONMENT FOR LI-ION BATTERY DISASSEMBLY WORK
prerequisites: Must be an indoor environment.

text_blocks.text: ENVIRONMENT FOR LI-ION BATTERY DISASSEMBLY WORK
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: The environment must utilize a shutter or other means to shut out the outside environment and prevent rain, snow, dust, or other substances from entering.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The environment must not cause the intrusion of sweat during work, or cause condensation to occur due to high temperature or humidity.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Metal powder, grease, and other foreign substances must not enter.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The indoor environment must also prevent metal powder, grease, and other foreign substances from entering due to maintenance performed on other vehicles and other sources during disassembly work.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: If there is a risk of the above substances entering, take appropriate countermeasures, such as use of a vinyl curtain or an equivalent to shut out the outside environment.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The floor must not be wet as a result of factors such as vehicle entry during rain or snow.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: The work space must be approximately the size of one entire vehicle.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Take appropriate countermeasures so that persons other than the operator do not enter the work space, such as by placing signs indicating that disassembly work is in progress.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Always place a standard fire fighting equipment in the disassembly work area.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Depending  on  type  of  fire  (vehicle  or  battery)  use  standard  fire  fighting  equipment  (water  or  extinguisher).
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Remove harness bracket , and from the rear module stack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Follow the following procedure and remove the bus bar from the rear module stack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Remove the center bus bar cover, then remove the module terminal mounting bolts .
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: There  is  the  danger  of  electric  shock  caused  by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: This work must not be performed by multiple operators because there is a risk of electric shock if the operators contact one another. CAUTION:
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Do not remove all bus bar covers and all module terminal mounting bolts at the same time.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Remove the left-side bus bar cover, then remove the module terminal mounting bolts .
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: There  is  the  danger  of  electric  shock  caused  by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: This work must not be performed by multiple operators because there is a risk of electric shock if the operators contact one another.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Remove the right-side bus bar cover, then remove the module terminal mounting bolts .
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: There  is  the  danger  of  electric  shock  caused  by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: This work must not be performed by multiple operators because there is a risk of electric shock if the operators contact one another.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Remove  the  voltage  detection  terminal  mounting  screws , then remove the bus bar from the rear module stack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: There  is  the  danger  of  electric  shock  caused  by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: This work must not be performed by multiple opera-
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: tors because there is a risk of electric shock if the operators contact one another.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Install a module terminal cover [SST: KV99111500 ( -)] (A) onto all module terminals.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Because 'module B' interferes with the bracket and cover, cut the module terminal cover at the position shown in the figure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Fasten the rear module stack with a lashing belt . WARNING:
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Remove the through bolt mounting nut, then disassemble the rear module stack .
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: When replacing the Li-ion battery with a new battery, perform the following operation.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Enter the date of the (replacement) work on the EV battery tracking identification seal that is packaged together with the new part.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Cut the EV battery tracking identification tool into 2 pieces and apply them to the body of the replaced (old) LI-ion battery and to the 'Li-ion battery replacement history record'.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Enter the necessary information in the 'Li-ion battery replacement history record'.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Follow the procedure below to assemble the rear module.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Assemble the rear module so that the module terminals are arranged as shown in the figure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: Be careful of the directions of the + terminal and -terminal when assembling the module. If the polarity is incorrect, there is a risk of electric shock, fire, and component damage.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: To identify the module + terminal and -terminal, refer to the figure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Use  a  lashing  belt and  apply  pressure  to  the  rear  module stack .
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Inspect the module installation condition, and correct it if it is skewed or a large distortion is found.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Install the 2 through-bolts at opposite corners of the module, then insert φ 7 mm (0.28 in) metal bars (A) into the bolt holes and tighten the mounting nuts to the prescribed torque.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: CAUTION: If the collar position is incorrect, there is a risk of the bolts loosening because they are not supported by the collar between the modules.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Install the remaining 2 through-bolts, and tighten the mounting nuts to the prescribed torque.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When installing, hold the end of the through bolt stationary and tighten the installation nut.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Remove the module terminal cover [SST: KV99111500 ( -)] (A).
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Follow the procedure below and install the bus bar module onto the rear module stack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Install the bus bar module onto the rear module stack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Use an insulated torque driver (A) and tighten the voltage detection terminal mounting screws to the prescribed torque.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: There  is  the  danger  of  electric  shock  caused  by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: This work must not be performed by multiple opera-
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: tors because there is a risk of electric shock if the operators contact one another.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Tighten the module terminal mounting bolts in numerical order as shown in the figure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When tightening of 1 - 16 is completed, install the left-side bus bar cover.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When tightening of 17 - 32 is completed, install the right-side bus bar cover.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: When tightening of 33 - 48 is completed, install the center bus bar cover.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: There is the danger of electric shock caused by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: This work must not be performed by multiple operators because there is a risk of electric shock if the operators contact one another.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Be careful not to install with the top and bottom facing in the wrong directions.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: After installation, check that the mating is not skewed.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: LI-ION BATTERY
prerequisites: Be sure to reinstall the high voltage harness clips in their original positions. If a clip is damaged, replace it with a new clip before installing.

text_blocks.text: Install the harness bracket , and to the rear module stack.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Be sure to reinstall the high voltage harness clips in their original positions. If a clip is damaged, replace it with a new clip before installing.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Check the following items after installing battery pack: Refer to EVB-269, "Inspection".
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Remove the plug and install the adapter (A) of the air leak tester [SST: KV99111400 ( -)].
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Install  the  gauge  (A)  of  the  air  leak  tester  [SST:  KV99111400 ( -)].
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: CAUTION: The gauge is a precision instrument. Be careful not to drop it when handling it.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: DANGER: There is the danger of electric shock caused by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Because the service plug location is open, install the service plug for sealing the case.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Use vinyl tape or similar means (A) for preventing air leakage from the PTC harness connector.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Use wide vinyl tape that is capable of covering all of the PTC harness connector with one strip.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Apply carefully so that no wrinkles in the tape occur.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Use vinyl tape or similar means (A) to prevent air leakage from the breather.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Use  wide  vinyl  tape  that  is  capable  of  covering  all  of  the breather with one strip.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Apply carefully so that no wrinkles in the tape occur.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Follow the procedure below to check the battery case pressure.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Open the cock on the air leak tester.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: CAUTION: Do not operate the pump before opening the cock on the air leak tester. Doing so may damage the gauge. If the pump is operated before the cock is opened, first disconnect the air pump hose to release the pressure.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: Operate the air pump slowly and apply the specified inspection pressure inside the battery pack. If the gauge pressure does not rise, or if the gauge reading fluctuates, check for the location of air leakage.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Operate the air pump carefully when applying pressure. If pressure is applied suddenly to the gauge, the gauge may be damaged.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Do not apply pressure of 2.0 kPa (0.0204 kg/cm 2 ) or more to the battery case or air leak tester.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: LI-ION BATTERY
prerequisites: Check that the air leak tester reading remains at or above the limit value.

text_blocks.text: Close the cock and wait for 1 minute.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Check that the air leak tester reading remains at or above the limit value.
text_blocks.label: list_item

chunks.heading: Repair limit : 1.4 kPa (0.014 bar, 0.0142 kg/cm 2 , 0.203 psi)

text_blocks.text: Repair limit : 1.4 kPa (0.014 bar, 0.0142 kg/cm 2 , 0.203 psi)
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: If the pressure is below the limit value, check for the locations of air leakage.
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Check for air leakage from the sound of air escaping when pressure is applied.
text_blocks.label: text

chunks.heading: ELECTRIC EQUIPOTENTIAL TEST
prerequisites: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.

text_blocks.text: After assembling the Li-ion battery pack, remove the battery pack upper case ground bolt , then measure the resistance between the high-voltage harness connector flange ground bolts and the ground bolt seat (location of coating peeling) .
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: WARNING: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_blocks.label: section_header

text_blocks.text: If the result deviates from the standard value, check the following and correct the malfunction location.
text_blocks.label: text

text_blocks.text: Corrosion on ground bolt mounting surface
text_blocks.label: list_item

text_blocks.text: Presence of paint, oil, dirt, or other substance on ground bolt mounting surface
text_blocks.label: list_item
